R1_flow_salsa_fresh_vs_in_juice.said: Got it: one salsa needs 8 cups of tomato. I still need one batch for each of tomatoes in juice and onion before I can work out salsa.
R1_flow_salsa_fresh_vs_in_juice.text: We made 1 salsa from 1 can tomatoes in juice, 8 cups fresh tomatoes and 4 onions and ran out of tomatoes.

R1_flow_salsa_fresh_vs_in_juice.said: Earlier batches say one salsa needs 8 cups of tomato; this one says 4 cups of tomato. Those can't both be right, so I kept what I had. Nothing was saved.
R1_flow_salsa_fresh_vs_in_juice.text: We made 1 salsa from 2 can tomatoes in juice, 4 cups fresh tomatoes and 4 onions and ran out of fresh tomatoes.

R1_flow_salsa_fresh_vs_in_juice.said: That batch doesn't add up: from what I've already learned, tomato would have run out at the same moment as onion. Nothing was saved.
R1_flow_salsa_fresh_vs_in_juice.text: We made 1 salsa from 2 can tomatoes in juice, 8 cups fresh tomatoes and 2 onions and ran out of onions.

R1_flow_salsa_fresh_vs_in_juice.said: Noted: we have 3 cans of tomatoes in juice, 6 cups of tomato, and 5 onions.
R1_flow_salsa_fresh_vs_in_juice.text: We have 3 can tomatoes in juice, 6 cups fresh tomatoes and 5 onions.

R1_flow_salsa_fresh_vs_in_juice.said: I can't say yet how much salsa we can make. I still need one batch for each of tomatoes in juice and onion: a batch where that one ran out first while everything else was left over. I didn't guess.
R1_flow_salsa_fresh_vs_in_juice.text: How much salsa can we make?

R3_fresh_said.said: Got it: one salsa needs 4 cups of tomato. I still need one batch for each of tomatoes in juice and onion before I can work out salsa.
R3_fresh_said.text: We made 1 salsa from 2 can tomatoes in juice, 4 cups fresh tomatoes and 4 onions and ran out of fresh tomatoes.

R3_tie.said: Tomato and tomatoes in juice ran out at the same time, so I can't tell which one set the limit. Nothing was saved.
R3_tie.text: We made 1 sauce from 2 can tomatoes in juice, 2 tomatoes and 4 onions and ran out of tomatoes and tomatoes in juice.

R3_tie_sugar.said: Sugar and sugar for dusting ran out at the same time, so I can't tell which one set the limit. Nothing was saved.
R3_tie_sugar.text: We made 1 cake from 1 cup sugar, 1 tablespoon sugar for dusting and 3 cups flour and ran out of sugar and sugar for dusting at the same time.
